title: Galois-invariant closed subsets of a Galois base change descend
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $\bar k/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] that is Galois, i.e. separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal (for every $\alpha\in\bar k$ the minimal polynomial of $\alpha$ over $k$ is a product of polynomials of degree one in $\bar k[T]$); it may be of infinite degree. Write $\operatorname{Aut}(\bar k/k)$ for the group of $k$-algebra automorphisms of $\bar k$. Let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] and $X_{\bar k}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ its base change [def-pc-base-change]. For $\sigma\in\operatorname{Aut}(\bar k/k)$ let $\sigma_X=\mathrm{id}_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma):X_{\bar k}\to X_{\bar k}$ be the base change of the $k$-morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma):\operatorname{Spec}\bar k\to\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]; it is an automorphism of the scheme $X_{\bar k}$, and $(\sigma\circ\tau)_X=\tau_X\circ\sigma_X$. Let $p:X_{\bar k}\to X$ be the projection. Let $\bar T\subseteq X_{\bar k}$ be a closed subset such that $\sigma_X(\bar T)=\bar T$ for every $\sigma\in\operatorname{Aut}(\bar k/k)$. Then there is a closed subset $T\subseteq X$ with $p^{-1}(T)=\bar T$.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma Tag 038B (lemma-closed-fixed-by-Galois, lines 898--934), with the action of equation (equation-galois-action-base-change-kbar), lines 850--874
